comments.content:
When generating a JSON schema from a TypeBox schema in TypeScript, fields with default values are still marked as `required` in the resulting JSON schema. This behavior is inconsistent with the expectation that fields with default values should be optional.
We always use (or at least should always) use `Default` and `Decode` when using schemas which ensures that properties with `default` will be populated.
Few options available:
- use `Optional` but very tedious because it would add `undefined` to all the types
- use `{ required: false }` would be better but need to change all the types from our current schemas
- use a specific reviver when dumpling the JSON
Last one seems riskier but makes more sense because it would require no change from the plugins.
